rows.label: CGM readings per day
rows.envelope: 96 to 1,440 readings/day covers 15 min to 1 min intervals before power and buffering proof.
rows.evidenceRequired: Confirm sensor settling, BLE duty cycle, local buffering, timestamping and battery budget.

rows.label: CGM total wear readings
rows.envelope: Arithmetic only; storage, power and calibration drift need evidence.
rows.interpretation: 4032 readings over the stated wear period.
rows.evidenceRequired: Confirm memory, telemetry retries, battery capacity, sensor drift and calibration strategy.

rows.label: CGM MARD margin to 10%
rows.envelope: Positive margin to 10% target before clinical validation.
rows.interpretation: 1 percentage-point margin to a 10% MARD target.
rows.evidenceRequired: Confirm clinical protocol, comparator, calibration method, population mix and error-grid analysis.
